files.purpose: Shared @MainActor base class `OpenAICompatibleSession: ProviderSession` that is the complete in-app coding agent for the OpenAI Chat Completions style native providers DeepSeek, Meta and Z.ai (subclasses DeepSeekSession, MetaSession, ZaiSession supply a `Config` and override `applyProviderPayload`, `reasoningEffort(for:model:)` and `friendlyError`). It owns the conversation history as a JSON message array, posts it with `stream: true` over URLSession with a Bearer API key, drains the SSE stream on a detached task through a 30 ms text coalescer, runs a multi-round tool loop over six built-in file/shell tools plus MCPHub tools with approval gating, plan-mode blocking, Hydra head budgets, concurrent read batching (max 4), transport retries (2, after 1 s and 2 s), history condensing, trimming and tool-call-chain sanitizing, and emits ProviderEvents (message/reasoning deltas and completions, tool start/update, approvals, usage, tokenSpend, notices, plan, turn completion).

persisted_fields: None written by this file. History lives in memory; a relaunch rebuilds it from configuration.transcript (role user/assistant, plain text only, tool calls not restored). sessionID is the configuration.resumeID when given else a new lowercased UUID and is returned from start().
ui_elements: No views. User-visible strings emitted: approval options id "allow" title "Approve" role .approve; id "always" title "Approve for turn" role .approveAlways; id "decline" title "Decline" role .decline.

Approval titles: "Call <server> <name>" (MCP), "Read <displayPath>", list_files title = folder name or display path, "Search for “<pattern>”", "Write <displayPath>", "Edit <displayPath>", run_command title = the unwrapped command. Approval details: MCP detail args.compactString (line 900); read_file detail = raw `path` (923); list_files title = the row title (call.title) and detail = raw `path` (941); search_text detail = raw path or nil when empty (959); write_file, edit_file and run_command detail nil (972, 995, 1015). run_command approval title is the unwrapped command, "" when empty.

Tool row titles: MCP "<server> · <name>" with prettyString detail; read_file displayPath; list_files lastPathComponent of the working directory when path empty; search_text pattern or "Search" with detail displayPath; write/edit displayPath with edits; run_command command or "Run command"; unknown tool name with output "Unknown tool." status .failed.

Notices: "Nothing to compact yet." (info), "Context compacted." (info), "<title> paused after 200 rounds of tool calls in one turn. Say “continue” to pick up where it left off." (warning), "<title> lost the connection while answering. That reply was cut off, and this response is restarting." (warning).
Declined row output "The user declined this action." status .declined.
feature_notes: start(): throws ProviderError.notInstalled(config.kind) if trimmed apiKey empty; sessionID = configuration.resumeID ?? UUID().uuidString.lowercased(); clears interrupted/isStopping; if messages empty seeds [system prompt] plus each transcript message as {role: user|assistant, content: text}, then trimHistory(). Emits no .models event (comment: the registry owns the live catalog).
send(): throws notRunning unless sendTask == nil, sessionID != nil and !isStopping; runs performTurn in a Task stored in sendTask (cleared by defer), cancellation of the caller cancels that task.

performTurn order: cancelled -> finishInterrupted; guards; adopt input.runtimeMode/interactionMode, non-empty input.model; reset interrupted and approveAllRemaining; refreshSystemPrompt(); append user message (userContentValue) and trimHistory(); emit .turnStarted(providerTurnID: nil).

Round loop: up to maxRoundsPerTurn = 200 rounds (hitCeiling -> warning notice then .turnCompleted(.interrupted)). Hydra head budget: budgetSpent when isHydraHead and (toolsUsed >= HydraBudget.maxTools or elapsed >= HydraBudget.maxSeconds); if input.isFinalReport or budgetSpent, appends HydraBudget.finalNote as a user message only when budgetSpent, runs one round withTools: false, reports usage, throws friendlyError on rawError, appends assistant reply if non-empty, and breaks. Wrap-up: once per turn when head and (toolsUsed >= HydraBudget.wrapUpTools or elapsed >= wrapUpSeconds) appends HydraBudget.wrapUpNote. Pacing: when head and toolsSinceChange >= pacingAt appends HydraBudget.pacingNote and sets pacingAt = toolsSinceChange + HydraBudget.pacingTools. write_file/edit_file reset toolsSinceChange to 0 and pacingAt to HydraBudget.pacingTools. Order inside each loop pass (lines 311-341): Task.checkCancellation(); the 200-round ceiling guard; rounds += 1; budgetSpent computed; the final-report branch (appends finalNote only when budgetSpent, then streamOneRound(withTools: false) with NO condenseHistory() call, then break); otherwise the wrap-up note check (329-332) comes before the pacing note check (336-339), both after the budget check; then condenseHistory() (line 340) and only then the normal streamOneRound. condenseHistory therefore never runs before the final-report round (streamOneRound still calls sanitizeHistory() first in both paths, line 509).

Key rejection: statusCode 401, or rawError containing both "invalid" and "key" case-insensitively, throws "<title> rejected the API key. Check it in Settings → Providers → <title>."; any other non-empty rawError throws friendlyError(error, statusCode). This key check exists only in the normal tool-round path (lines 343-345). The final-report / budget-spent round (line 322) does `if let error = last.rawError, !error.isEmpty { throw ProviderError.failed(friendlyError(error, statusCode: last.statusCode)) }` with no key check, so a 401 or an "invalid ... key" error in that round never shows the key message.

A round with no tool calls appends the assistant reply (if content non-empty) and ends the turn; with tool calls the assistant turn with tool_calls is appended first, then tools execute in model order.

Concurrent reads: consecutive calls whose readOnlyKind is non-nil and which do not require approval are batched; executeReadBatch runs at most maxConcurrentReads = 4 in a task group and returns outputs in model order; each output appended as {role: tool, tool_call_id, content}. Anything else (write, command, MCP, unknown, or read needing approval) is a barrier run alone.

Turn end: CancellationError -> finishInterrupted (declines pending approvals, .turnCompleted(.interrupted)); ProviderError -> .turnCompleted(.failed, error.localizedDescription); other errors -> interrupted path if interrupted/cancelled else .turnCompleted(.failed, friendlyError(localizedDescription, 0)). In plan mode a non-empty trimmed finalText emits .planCompleted(id: nextID("plan"), markdown: finalText) before .turnCompleted(.completed).
interrupt(): sets interrupted, cancels sendTask, roundTask, sseDrain, resumes all pending approvals with false. stop(): same plus isStopping = true and sessionID = nil.
resolveApproval: optionID "always" sets approveAllRemaining; returns true for "allow" or "always"; emits .requestResolved. answerQuestion is an empty no-op.
compact(): if messages.count <= 12 emits info "Nothing to compact yet."; else keeps first (system) message plus last 10, sanitizeHistory(), emits info "Context compacted.".
reportUsage: emits .usage and TokenLedger.shared.record(spend: usage.usedTokens) when usage present; emits .tokenSpend with provider config.kind and model currentModel only when tokenUsage.hasSpend.

streamOneRound: sanitizeHistory(); loads MCP tools once when withTools; builds payload once; retry loop: cancellation/interrupt/stop throw CancellationError; non-transient failures rethrow underlying; after maxTransportRetries (2) throws terminalTransportMessage: "<title> could not reach the network after 3 attempts. Check the connection, then try again." plus " (<localizedDescription>)" when non-empty. Order in the StreamAttemptFailure catch (lines 532-552): cancel sseDrain; checkCancellation / interrupted-or-stopping -> CancellationError; non-transient -> rethrow underlying; `guard attempt < Self.maxTransportRetries` else throw terminalTransportMessage; only THEN, when failure.emittedOutput, the warning "<title> lost the connection while answering. That reply was cut off, and this response is restarting."; then sleep transportRetryDelays[min(attempt, 1)] (1 s then 2 s) and attempt += 1. So the cut-off notice is emitted only when a retry follows; the terminal third failure throws at line 542 before reaching line 547 and gets no cut-off notice even if output was shown. HTTP non-200 responses (429, 5xx and so on) are returned as a round with rawError, not thrown, so they are never retried. An error thrown while reading the non-200 body (`for try await line in bytes.lines`, line 636) is not wrapped in StreamAttemptFailure, so it falls to the generic `catch { roundTask = nil; throw error }` (553-556) and is not retried either.

requestPayload: {model, messages, stream: true}; withTools adds tools = toolDefinitions + mcpToolDefinitions and tool_choice "auto"; then applyProviderPayload (base: reasoning_effort = reasoningEffort(for:model:) when non-nil, base returns nil). Comment documents subclass intent: DeepSeek turns thinking on; Meta top-level reasoning_effort, "none" rejected with HTTP 400; Z.ai clear_thinking, max_tokens, tool_stream.

performStream: body encoded off main actor; ids nextID("message") and nextID("thought"); connection failure before streaming throws StreamAttemptFailure(emittedOutput: false); non-200 reads error body lines up to >8_000 chars and returns a round with statusCode and rawError = errorMessage(fromBody:). errorMessage: JSON error.message or message, else first 500 chars of trimmed body, else "<title> returned status <code>." Streamed rounds carry the fixed `let statusCode = 200` (line 621): a mid-stream JSON error goes into round.rawError with statusCode 200 (line 716-717) and reaches friendlyError(..., statusCode: 200) in performTurn, and the transport-error path also calls friendlyError(streamError, statusCode: statusCode) with 200 (line 697). performStream runs once per attempt, so nextID("message") and nextID("thought") (lines 610-611) are allocated on every attempt including retries, and the counter advances even when nothing streams.

SSE drain (detached, .userInitiated): lines trimmed, only lines starting "data:"; payload after 5 chars trimmed of whitespace; "[DONE]" ends; unparsable JSON skipped; json.error non-null -> streamError (error.message ?? displayText) and the chunk is `continue`d (line 751), so any usage or choices in that same chunk are ignored. usage: input = prompt_tokens ?? input_tokens; output = completion_tokens ?? output_tokens; cached = prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens ?? input_tokens_details.cached_tokens ?? prompt_cache_hit_tokens; total = total_tokens ?? input+output; ContextUsage(usedTokens: total, windowTokens: config.contextWindow) only when total > 0; ReportedTokenUsage always emitted. choices[0].delta.content -> text; delta.reasoning_content ?? delta.reasoning -> reasoning; delta.tool_calls[] -> index (default 0), id, function.name, function.arguments.

StreamCoalescer: text and reasoning are buffered separately, switching kind flushes the other; first piece schedules a detached flush after 30 ms; tool calls, usage, token usage and stream errors flush first; finish/fail are idempotent via finished.

Transport error mid-stream: if a streamError was seen throws friendlyError(streamError); if content already contains streamed Hydra delegations throws "<localizedDescription> This response was not retried because it had already streamed a head delegation."; otherwise StreamAttemptFailure(emittedOutput: sawContent || sawReasoning).
After stream: .messageCompleted if content seen, .reasoningCompleted if reasoning seen; tool calls from accumulators sorted by index, skipping empty names, missing id replaced by nextID("tool").
friendlyError base: empty -> "<title> stopped before finishing." else message.

Tool definitions verbatim descriptions: read_file "Read a file inside the project. Path is relative to the project root. The whole file by default; for a big file (hundreds of lines) pass start_line and line_count to read just the part you need, and the result says how many lines the file has." (path "Relative file path", required; start_line "First line to read, counted from 1"; line_count "How many lines to read from start_line"); list_files "List files in a directory inside the project." (path "Relative directory, empty for the root", recursive boolean); search_text "Search file contents for a fixed string or regex." (pattern required, path "Relative directory or file", regex boolean); write_file "Create or overwrite a file inside the project with the full new content." (path, content required); edit_file "Replace one exact block of text in a file with new text. old_string must appear exactly once." (path, old_string, new_string required); run_command "Run a shell command in the project root and capture its output." (command required).

executeTool: returns "Stopped." when cancelled/interrupted. MCP: failure output text or "Error: the MCP tool reported failure with no output."; success row summary limit 12_000, model gets text or "(no output)"; thrown error -> "Error: <desc>". read_file row summary limit 4_000; list_files 4_000 (recursive default false); search_text 6_000; write_file returns "Wrote <displayPath> (<utf8 bytes> bytes)."; edit_file accepts old_string/old_text and new_string/new_text, returns "Edited <displayPath>."; run_command: `let command = ToolTitles.unwrapShell(args["command"]?.string ?? "")` (line 1012) and runCommand(command) (line 1018) executes that unwrapped string, never the model's raw command; row title is command or "Run command" when empty, but the approval title is `command` itself (so "" when empty) with detail nil (line 1015); row exitCode and status .completed only for exit 0, model gets "(exit N, no output)" or "exit N\n<summary 12_000>"; unknown -> "Error: unknown tool <name>.". Declined -> row updated with output "The user declined this action." status .declined and model gets "The user declined this action. Ask how to proceed instead of retrying it." (declined(), lines 1035-1037). approveIfNeeded returns false immediately when `interrupted` (line 1060), and executeTool then still calls declined(callID), so a call refused because the turn was interrupted is marked declined, not stopped.

requiresApproval: planBlocks = plan mode and kind .edit or .command; approveAllRemaining bypasses only when not planBlocks; planBlocks always asks; else supervised -> true, autoAcceptEdits/auto -> kind == .command, fullAccess -> false. approveIfNeeded returns false immediately when interrupted; maps .command -> .command, .edit -> .fileChange, other -> .tool; emits .approval with toolItemID nil; cancellation removes and declines the continuation.

condenseHistory: when total utf8 bytes of tool messages > 160_000, walks all but the last 10 tool messages while total > 100_000; condenses those > 1_200 bytes without the marker to first 400 characters + "\n…[Droppy Code condensed this output (<bytes> bytes); call the tool again if you need it]".

searchText: empty pattern -> "Error: a search pattern is required."; empty path -> "." else fileTools.resolveURL(path).path (error -> "Error: <desc>"); Shell failure -> "Search failed."; empty output -> "(no matches)"; more than 120 lines -> first 120 plus "\n…(<count> matches, truncated)".

runCommand: empty -> ("Error: a command is required.", 1); start failure -> ("The command could not start.", 1); output = stdout + ("\n" + stderr if any), trimmed; over 24_000 utf8 bytes keeps "…" + last 24_000 characters.

systemPrompt mode lines verbatim: plan "You are in PLAN mode: research the project, then write a clear step-by-step plan. Do not edit files or run commands that change anything; reads, lists and searches are fine."; build+supervised "You are in BUILD mode with supervised permissions: use tools freely but the user approves each one in Droppy Code."; build+autoAcceptEdits/auto "You are in BUILD mode: read and edit files freely; the user approves shell commands in Droppy Code."; build+fullAccess "You are in BUILD mode with full access: use tools freely without asking.". Header "You are Droppy Code's <agentIdentity(currentModel)>, working inside <workingDirectory> on macOS."; then the mode line, then the line "Rules:" and these bullets verbatim (lines 1205-1212): "- Prefer the provided tools over asking the user to run things. Read files before editing them." / "- Keep file paths relative to the project root and never touch paths outside it." / "- Report the result and material limitations when the task is complete." / "- Never hard-wrap prose at a fixed column: write each paragraph of a reply as one unbroken
  line, however long, so a copied reply keeps its full line length wherever it is pasted.
  Lines inside a fenced code block keep their own breaks." (the hard-wrap bullet carries two embedded newlines, each continuation line indented two spaces) / "- If a tool result shows the user declined an action, do not retry it: ask how to proceed." / "- Today's date is <ISO8601.string(from: Date())>.". Line 1213 is `
\(appendedPolicy)`, so one blank line separates the date bullet from appendedPolicy (the prompt would end in "

" only if appendedPolicy were empty, which cannot happen because the anti-slop text is always present). policy = [configuration.hydra.map(HydraPrompts.fallbackPolicy), AntiSlopPolicy.instructions(enabled: configuration.antiSlopEnabled)].compactMap{$0}.joined(separator: "

"); appendedPolicy = [policy or nil when empty, guidance.systemPromptBlock()].compactMap{$0}.joined(separator: "

"), so the project guidance comes last. Source comment lines 1188-1189: "The optional Hydra policy and the anti-slop guidance go in once each. The off notice goes out too, so a resumed thread cannot keep earlier guidance alive." AntiSlopPolicy.instructions(enabled:) returns a non-optional String (AntiSlopPolicy.swift line 16: `enabled ? enabledInstructions : disabledInstructions`), so with anti-slop off the prompt still carries "[Droppy Code anti-slop guidance: off]
Disregard earlier app-provided anti-slop guidance. Continue following user requests and project requirements." refreshSystemPrompt replaces messages[0] each turn only if it is a system message.

userContentValue: up to 4 image attachments; non-vision model or none -> string, with "\n\n[Attached images (model cannot see them): <names>]" appended when images existed; vision -> array of {type: text} + {type: image_url, image_url: {url: data:<mime>;base64,<b64>}}.
assistantTurn: {role: assistant, content}; reasoning_content added when config.replaysReasoning; tool_calls {id, type: function, function {name, arguments}} when present.
trimHistory: only when messages.count > 60; keeps system + up to (50 - current turn size) earlier messages + the entire current turn from the last user message.

sanitizeHistory: drops tool messages without a matching open tool_call id; strips unanswered tool_calls from assistant messages, removing the message entirely if its trimmed content is empty. Exact algorithm (lines 1270-1323): `open` holds assistant messages awaiting answers; any non-tool message calls closeOpen() before being appended (line 1319), and so does every new assistant message with non-empty tool_calls (line 1313), so a tool answer separated from its assistant message by a user or system message is dropped. closeOpen() keeps only calls whose `id` is a non-empty string not still unanswered (line 1281), so calls with a missing or empty id are stripped from assistants that had an open entry. An assistant whose calls all lack ids gets no open entry (`if !ids.isEmpty`, line 1316) and is appended with its tool_calls unchanged. Removals run last-index-first.

summary: truncates to limit characters + "\n…(truncated)" only when both utf8 count and character count exceed limit. nextID: counter += 1 then `"\(prefix)-\(counter)-\(UUID().uuidString.prefix(8))"` (line 1334): the first 8 characters of UUID().uuidString, which Foundation renders uppercase, unlike sessionID which uses `UUID().uuidString.lowercased()` (line 249).

B1->B2: Only mechanical helper substitutions, no behavior change intended: 10 call sites replaced `.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)` with the new `String.trimmed` extension (apiKey at line 243, plan finalText check line 431, SSE line trim line 744, errorMessage body line 797, searchText pattern line 1119 and path line 1127, searchText output line 1147, runCommand command line 1155 and output line 1162, sanitizeHistory content line 1286), and the system prompt date line 1212 changed from `ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: Date())` to `ISO8601.string(from: Date())` (new Core/Support/ISO8601.swift, Date.ISO8601FormatStyle() plain, whole seconds UTC with Z). Line 746 still uses `.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)` for the data payload. Line count unchanged at 1336.
unresolved_questions: Whether ISO8601.string(from:) output is byte-identical to the B1 ISO8601DateFormatter default output (both appear to be yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ in UTC) was not verified at runtime.

Windows replacements for /bin/zsh -lc, /usr/bin/grep and LoginEnvironment.current, and whether the "on macOS." wording in the system prompt must be preserved, are owner/platform decisions not resolvable from this file.
Subclass Config values (URLs, models, context windows, effort maps, friendly errors) live in DeepSeekSession.swift, MetaSession.swift and ZaiSession.swift, not read in this bundle.
HydraBudget constants and note texts, NativeFileTools path guard semantics and ToolTitles.unwrapShell are defined elsewhere and not read here.

files.purpose: `PiSession` is the @MainActor ProviderSession that drives the external Pi coding harness as a long-lived `pi --mode rpc` child process speaking LF-delimited JSONL over stdin/stdout, one process per thread. It launches pi with a Droppy extension (`-e`, installed by PiCLI) and a per-launch gate JSON file that the extension reads before each tool call, translates pi's message/tool/extension_ui events into ProviderEvents, turns `droppy-gate` select requests into app approval cards with session grants, maps pi's confirm/input/editor/select dialogs to app questions, and uses pi's session file path as the resume id.

side_effects: Installs the pi extension via PiCLI.installExtension() and optionally the MCP bridge via MCPBridge.installBridge()
Creates directory <PiCLI.supportDirectory>/gates and writes an atomic gate JSON file per launch, rewritten at each send; deletes it on stop()
Spawns pi with arguments and environment, writes JSONL requests to its stdin, terminates it on stop
Reads files (up to 1_000_000 bytes, UTF-8) to snapshot before a pi `write` tool call for diffs
Reads image attachment bytes and base64-encodes them into the prompt
platform_assumptions: FileManager.default.fileExists / createDirectory / removeItem; URL(fileURLWithPath:) resourceValues .fileSizeKey; String(contentsOf:encoding: .utf8); Data(contentsOf:).
StdioProcess with line framing (POSIX pipes on macOS); process exit status Int32; errorTail.
Model string split at the first "/" into provider and model id.
unifiedDiff has `let relative = path.hasPrefix("/") ? path : path` (both branches identical), so absolute POSIX paths pass through unchanged; Windows paths with drive letters would also pass through.
Pi's resume state lives in `~/.pi/agent` per the header comment; the session file path is a POSIX absolute path checked with fileExists.
Environment variables DROPPY_CODE_PI_GATE, PI_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK, DROPPY_CODE_MCP_BRIDGE, DROPPY_CODE_MCP_CONFIG.
persisted_fields: Gate file JSON {"runtimeMode": runtimeMode.rawValue, "interactionMode": interactionMode.rawValue, "finalReport": Bool, "systemPrompt": ""} at <PiCLI.supportDirectory>/gates/<UUID>.json, written atomically, removed on stop().
Resume id: pi's reported data.sessionFile (preferred) or data.sessionId from get_state, returned from start() and used as --session on relaunch.
ui_elements: No views. Approval options: id "allow" title "Approve" role .approve; id "always" title "Approve for session" role .approveAlways; id "deny" title "Decline" role .decline.

Question header "Pi"; confirm choices "Yes" and "No"; input/editor question with prompt params.title ?? "Pi", no choices, allowsOther true; non-gate select shows title as prompt and options as choices.

Notices: "Compacting the conversation…" (info), "Conversation compacted" (info, no period), auto_retry_start error text or "Pi is retrying." (warning), extension_error text or "Pi reported an extension error." (error), notify message or "Pi sent a notification." with notifyType warning/error/else info.

Tool row titles: bash -> unwrapped command (default "bash"); read/edit/write -> path relative to working directory; grep/find -> pattern; ls -> path or "."; mcp__ -> "<server> · <tool>" (server = second "__" part or "MCP", tool = remaining parts joined by "__" or the full name) with pretty args detail, nil when args null or "{}"; others -> name with pretty args detail, nil when args null or "{}".
feature_notes: start(): no executable -> ProviderError.notInstalled(configuration.provider); resume sessionID whose file does not exist -> ProviderError.failed("Pi no longer has this conversation; starting a new one."). Arguments: ["--mode", "rpc", "-e", <extension path>], then "--approve" when runtimeMode is .auto or .fullAccess else "--no-approve"; model non-empty, not "default", containing "/" -> "--provider" <before slash> "--model" <after slash>; effort in PiCLI.thinkingLevels -> "--thinking" <effort>; resume -> "--session" <sessionID>. Environment: configuration.environment + DROPPY_CODE_PI_GATE=<gate path>, PI_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK="1", DROPPY_CODE_MCP_BRIDGE=<bridge path> if installBridge succeeds, DROPPY_CODE_MCP_CONFIG=<MCPPaths.claudeConfigURL.path> if that file exists. Process start error -> "Pi could not start: <desc>". When get_state has no non-empty `sessionFile` and start falls back to `data.sessionId` (lines 139-140), that non-path id becomes the returned resume id; on the next launch `FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: sessionID)` (line 82) fails for it and start throws "Pi no longer has this conversation; starting a new one.", so the sessionId fallback cannot resume. The `--approve`/`--no-approve` flag (line 93) is fixed at launch: send() updates runtimeMode/interactionMode and rewrites only the gate file (lines 162-164), never the pi process flag, so a mode change mid-session keeps the launch flag.

After spawn: reader task forwards each message to handle(), then awaits exit and calls didClose(status:). Sends get_state; sessionID = data.sessionFile else data.sessionId; contextWindow = data.model.contextWindow; emits .sessionReady(sessionID ?? ""). Sends get_commands; data.commands[] with name and description -> SlashCommand list, emitted only when non-empty. Sets started = true, stopped = false.
request(): id "droppy-<n>", resolves on the matching `response` line or with .null after 30 seconds.

send(): requires isRunning and process (else notRunning); turnActive -> failed("Pi is still on the last turn."). Adopts modes, rewrites gate with finalReport = input.isFinalReport. Model change (non-empty, differs, contains "/") sends {type: set_model, provider, modelId} then re-reads get_state for contextWindow. Effort change within PiCLI.thinkingLevels sends {type: set_thinking_level, level}. Resets turn state, turnCounter += 1, sends {type: prompt, message: text, images: [{type: image, data: base64, mimeType}]} (images key only when any readable image attachment), emits .turnStarted(providerTurnID: nil). Images: every attachment with isImage whose bytes load via `try? Data(contentsOf: image.url)` (read synchronously on the main actor, lines 188-191) is sent, with no count cap and no vision check, unlike OpenAICompatibleSession, which caps at 4 (`prefix(4)`) and gates on config.isVisionModel.

interrupt(): interruptRequested = true and sends {type: abort}. compact(): requires running, sends {type: compact}. stop(): stopped = true, terminate process, cancel reader, delete gate file. stopAgent always false. stop() (lines 212-222) does not end an active turn, does not reset turnActive and does not resume pendingResponses, pendingApprovals or pendingQuestions; a pending request() resolves only through its 30 s timeout task (lines 268-272).

resolveApproval: role .approveAlways -> value "Allow for session" and inserts grantKey(kind) into sessionGrants; .decline/.cancel/nil -> "Deny"; .approve -> "Allow"; sends {type: extension_ui_response, id, value}; emits .requestResolved. Grant asymmetry: resolveApproval inserts Self.grantKey(request.kind) ("command", "fileChange" or "tool", line 232) but handleSelect tests `sessionGrants.contains(kindString)` against the RAW payload kind (`payload["kind"]?.string ?? "tool"`, lines 602-603). A gate kind other than those three strings maps to .tool (line 609), so "Approve for session" stores "tool" but never auto-answers that raw kind again. An auto-answered gate sends value "Allow" (not "Allow for session", line 604) and emits no .requestResolved and no .approval.
answerQuestion: empty answers -> {type: extension_ui_response, id, cancelled: true}; confirm -> confirmed: (first == "Yes"); otherwise value: first answer; emits .requestResolved.

handle(): `response` resumes a pending request, else a failed `prompt` response (success false) sets turnError from error ?? message ?? "Pi reported an error." and finishes the turn; message_start (assistant only) opens "<launchID>-m-<n>" and resets buffers; message_update -> handleUpdate; message_end -> handleMessageEnd(message.message ?? message); tool_execution_start/update/end; agent_end -> finishTurn(); compaction_start/end, auto_retry_start, extension_error notices; extension_ui_request -> handleExtensionUI. A `response` without a string `id` is ignored entirely (`guard let id = message["id"]?.string else { return }`, line 303); the failed-prompt path requires `message["command"]?.string == "prompt"` and `message["success"]?.bool == false` and runs only when no pending request matches the id.

handleUpdate: event = assistantMessageEvent ?? event; text_delta opens a message id if none and emits messageDelta; thinking_delta opens "<launchID>-t-<n>" (resetting thinkingText) and emits reasoningDelta. Usage from `message["usage"] ?? event["usage"] ?? .null` (line 369), where `message` is the whole message_update line (its TOP-LEVEL usage) and event = message["assistantMessageEvent"] ?? message["event"]; it is evaluated after the switch on every message_update except a text_delta or thinking_delta whose delta is missing or empty (those `return` early at lines 350/358); windowTokens is the optional contextWindow, which may be nil; used = totalTokens ?? (input|inputTokens + output|outputTokens + cacheRead|cacheReadTokens + cacheWrite|cacheWriteTokens); emits .usage(ContextUsage(usedTokens: used, windowTokens: contextWindow)) when > 0. No tokenSpend event is emitted by this file.

handleMessageEnd (assistant only): final text = joined text blocks of content if non-empty else streamed messageText; reasoningCompleted only when trimmed thinkingText non-empty; messageCompleted and lastReplyText when a message id exists; stopReason "error" sets turnError = errorMessage ?? "Pi reported an error.".

handleToolStart: kinds bash -> .command, read -> .read, edit/write -> .edit, grep/find/ls -> .search, mcp__ prefix -> .mcp, else .other; args = args ?? input; write with path snapshots the current file (<= 1_000_000 bytes) for the diff. tool_execution_update emits .toolOutput with partialResult.content text when non-empty. Snapshot uses `URL(fileURLWithPath: path)` with pi's raw args.path (line 497), so a relative path resolves against the app process's current directory, not configuration.workingDirectory. A failed read or a file over 1_000_000 bytes is stored as "" (`Self.snapshot(path) ?? ""`, line 413), so the write diff then shows every non-empty line of the new content as an addition with no deletions. MCP rows (lines 439-443): `name.split(separator: "__", omittingEmptySubsequences: true)`, server = parts[1] or "MCP" when absent, tool = parts[2...] joined by "__" or the full name when absent; for both MCP and other tools detail is nil when args are null or `args.compactString == "{}"`, else args.prettyString.

handleToolEnd: output = text of result.content; isError from message.isError or result.isError; status completed, or declined when error output starts with "The user declined this", else failed; exitCode from result.details.exitCode; edits for edit (oldText/newText) or write (snapshot vs content) as a minimal diff: header "--- a/<path>\n+++ b/<path>" then every non-empty old line prefixed "-" and every non-empty new line prefixed "+", with ToolTitles.diffStats counts.

finishTurn (only if turnActive): plan mode with no error, no interrupt and non-empty trimmed lastReplyText emits .planCompleted(id: "<launchID>-plan-<turnCounter>"); then .turnCompleted interrupted if interruptRequested, else failed with error, else completed; resets interruptRequested.

handleExtensionUI: id = id ?? requestId, method required, params = params ?? message. select -> handleSelect; confirm -> question with prompt title (default "Pi") and message joined by newline; input/editor -> free-text question; notify -> notice; setStatus, setWidget, setTitle, set_editor_text and unknown methods ignored.

handleSelect: title not starting with "droppy-gate " or unparsable JSON -> ordinary select question. Gate payload: kind (default "tool"); a kind already in sessionGrants is answered "Allow" immediately with no card. Otherwise kind command/fileChange/else tool; command title unwrapShell(input.command ?? toolName) detail input.command; fileChange title relativePath(input.path ?? toolName) detail input.path; tool title toolName detail pretty input unless null or "{}"; toolItemID payload.toolCallId; emits .approval.

didClose: tail = TextCleanup.lastLines(process.errorTail); an active turn completes as interrupted (if requested) or failed with the tail as error; if not stopped, started = false and emits .exited(error: nil) on status 0 else "Pi exited with status <status>" plus "\n<tail>" when tail non-empty. didClose emits .turnCompleted directly (line 643) without finishTurn's plan-completion step and does not reset interruptRequested.

Header comment states the policy the extension enforces: Supervised asks for all, Auto-accept edits waves file changes through, Auto also passes shell commands that only read, Full access returns before asking, Plan mode is read-only from the extension's own prompt.

B1->B2: Two mechanical substitutions of `.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)` with the new `String.trimmed` extension: the thinkingText non-empty check in handleMessageEnd (line 393) and the lastReplyText check in finishTurn's plan-completion condition (line 520). No other change; line count unchanged at 654.
unresolved_questions: PiCLI.installExtension(), PiCLI.supportDirectory and PiCLI.thinkingLevels values, and the extension's gate logic, live in PiCLI and are not read in this bundle.
On Windows, how `pi` is resolved and launched (npm shim .cmd vs node script) and whether pi's RPC session file paths and ~/.pi/agent location behave the same is not answerable from this file.

The `resolveApproval` switch on the option role lists .approveAlways, .decline, .cancel, nil and .approve with no default; the full case list of ApprovalRequest.Option.Role is defined elsewhere and was not checked in this bundle.
